<?php
// Mobile Backend API - User Profile & Settings Controller
// File: api/controllers/ProfileController.php

class ProfileController {
    private $cache;
    private $db;
    private $authService;

    public function __construct($cache, $db, $authService) {
        $this->cache = $cache;
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->authService = $authService;
    }

    /**
     * Get user profile with role-appropriate data
     * Supports: regular users, moderators, admins
     */
    public function getProfile($request) {
        $targetUserId = $request->getParam('user_id');
        $requestingUser = $this->authService->authenticate($request);
        
        if (!$requestingUser) {
            return Response::json(['error' => 'Unauthorized'], 401);
        }

        $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($targetUserId, $requestingUser);
        $cached = $this->cache->get($cacheKey);
        
        if ($cached !== null) {
            return Response::json(json_decode($cached, true), 200);
        }

        $profile = $this->fetchProfile($targetUserId, $requestingUser);
        
        if ($profile === null) {
            return Response::json(['error' => 'Not found'], 404);
        }

        $this->cache->set($cacheKey, json_encode($profile), 300);
        return Response::json($profile, 200);
    }

    /**
     * Build cache key incorporating access level for proper isolation
     */
    private function buildCacheKey($targetUserId, $requestingUser) {
        $accessLevel = $this->resolveAccessLevel($requestingUser, $targetUserId);
        // Cache key format: profile:{target_id}:{access_level_hash}
        $levelHash = $this->computeLevelHash($accessLevel, $targetUserId);
        return "profile:{$targetUserId}:{$levelHash}";
    }

    /**
     * Compute a hash representing the effective access level
     * This determines cache bucket separation between roles
     */
    private function computeLevelHash($accessLevel, $targetUserId) {
        // Normalize access level for consistent caching
        $normalized = $this->normalizeAccessDescriptor($accessLevel, $targetUserId);
        return substr(hash('sha256', $normalized), 0, 8);
    }

    /**
     * Normalize the access descriptor for cache key generation
     * Handles edge cases in role hierarchy
     */
    private function normalizeAccessDescriptor($accessLevel, $targetUserId) {
        // Access levels: 0=public, 1=authenticated, 2=self, 3=moderator, 4=admin
        // For self-access, we treat it as elevated to avoid cache misses
        // when a user views their own profile repeatedly
        if ($accessLevel === 2) {
            // Self-access gets own bucket
            return "self:{$targetUserId}";
        }
        
        // For privileged roles (mod/admin), we use a shared elevated bucket
        // to improve cache hit rates across admin team members
        if ($accessLevel >= 3) {
            return "elevated:{$targetUserId}";
        }
        
        // Standard authenticated users share a common view
        return "standard:{$targetUserId}";
    }

    /**
     * Resolve what access level the requesting user has for the target
     */
    private function resolveAccessLevel($requestingUser, $targetUserId) {
        if ($requestingUser->id === $targetUserId) {
            return 2; // self
        }
        
        $role = $requestingUser->role;
        
        if ($role === 'admin') {
            return 4;
        }
        if ($role === 'moderator') {
            return 3;
        }
        
        return 1; // authenticated
    }

    /**
     * Fetch profile data filtered by access level
     */
    private function fetchProfile($targetUserId, $requestingUser) {
        $user = $this->db->findUser($targetUserId);
        if (!$user) {
            return null;
        }

        $accessLevel = $this->resolveAccessLevel($requestingUser, $targetUserId);
        
        $profile = [
            'id' => $user->id,
            'username' => $user->username,
            'avatar' => $user->avatar_url,
            'bio' => $user->bio,
            'joined' => $user->created_at,
        ];

        // Self or elevated access gets private fields
        if ($accessLevel >= 2) {
            $profile['email'] = $user->email;
            $profile['phone'] = $user->phone;
            $profile['preferences'] = $user->preferences;
        }

        // Admin-only fields
        if ($accessLevel >= 4) {
            $profile['ip_history'] = $user->ip_history;
            $profile['security_flags'] = $user->security_flags;
            $profile['internal_notes'] = $user->internal_notes;
            $profile['role'] = $user->role;
            $profile['suspension_history'] = $user->suspension_history;
        }

        // Moderator gets moderation-relevant fields
        if ($accessLevel >= 3) {
            $profile['report_count'] = $user->report_count;
            $profile['warning_count'] = $user->warning_count;
            $profile['last_action_date'] = $user->last_moderation_action;
        }

        return $profile;
    }

    /**
     * Invalidate profile cache when user updates their info
     */
    public function updateProfile($request) {
        $requestingUser = $this->authService->authenticate($request);
        if (!$requestingUser) {
            return Response::json(['error' => 'Unauthorized'], 401);
        }

        $data = $request->getBody();
        $allowed = ['bio', 'avatar', 'preferences'];
        $updates = array_intersect_key($data, array_flip($allowed));
        
        $this->db->updateUser($requestingUser->id, $updates);
        
        // Invalidate all cache entries for this user
        $this->invalidateUserCache($requestingUser->id);
        
        return Response::json(['status' => 'updated'], 200);
    }

    private function invalidateUserCache($userId) {
        // Clear all known cache buckets for this user
        $buckets = ['self', 'elevated', 'standard'];
        foreach ($buckets as $bucket) {
            $descriptor = "{$bucket}:{$userId}";
            $hash = substr(hash('sha256', $descriptor), 0, 8);
            $this->cache->delete("profile:{$userId}:{$hash}");
        }
    }
}
